register_gap: The app already owns the onboarding's ingredients (serif heroes, hairlines, receipt rows) but runs 6 to 9 simultaneous typographic registers per screen where onboarding permits 3, and stacks three letterspaced caps eyebrows above the Home hero where onboarding allows exactly one per screen. Deliberate emptiness collapses from onboarding's 40-70% of the canvas to roughly 10-15%, and a container grammar onboarding never uses returns everywhere: 7-8 outline pills on the evening screen, a seven-row chevron table on becoming, three-up stat tiles on the weight page, iMessage bubbles with tails in chat, and a ~90pt floating tab capsule that physically occludes content on two screens. Worst, the app truncates its own editorial voice ("this is day 12, n..." in p5_functional_home; "FINDING STEA…" in p4_list_home): a luxury object never ellipsizes itself. The register change needed is not new material, it is subtraction, scale discipline, and pacing.
onboarding_dna: One serif hero per screen at 44-52pt, two lines maximum, exactly one italic Fraunces-style punch word; the nearest competing text is 17pt, a true 2.5x scale jump (beats 03, 05, 10). The app's largest jump is ~1.7x because intermediate registers fill the gap.

Exactly one letterspaced caps eyebrow per screen (11-12pt, wide tracking, quiet taupe: HER ARRIVAL, HER FOOD STORY); no second caps register exists anywhere in the flow. Home shows three before the hero, becoming shows nine down one screen.

Zero elevated surfaces on cream: no cards, tiles, or bubbles. Choices are bare text rows over 1px #EFE0DC hairlines at ~90pt pitch (beats 03, 08). Elevation appears once in 22 beats, and only when UI rides a photograph (the snap sheet, beat 13).

40-70% of the canvas is deliberate, shaped emptiness; short content is optically centered, not top-hung (beat 05 centers the statement at ~45% vertical with the top 40% clear; beat 19 centers the receipt). The app top-loads everything and leaves raw voids at the bottom.
Numbers are typography, not widgets: 64-72pt serif numerals with 24-28pt italic serif unit words (500 calories +/- 75, 41g protein, beat 13); never rings, bars, or stat tiles.
Receipt grammar for data: label-left in 16pt light sans, value-right in 22-24pt cocoa carrying the italic punch (you said / food is fuel, beat 19), one hairline between rows, no chevrons.
At most one CTA per screen: a 64pt-tall full-width cocoa pill (show me, beat 10), or no chrome at all (tap to continue as bare quiet text, beat 19). Never two exits.
Photography, when present, is full-bleed edge to edge (top ~48% of beat 13) and the UI yields to it as a single rising sheet; imagery is never framed inside a card.

screen_directions.direction: One eyebrow, one hero, one numeral, then air. Keep only the date line (MONDAY, JULY 27) as the single caps register; the day/week/phase eyebrow and the truncated FROM JENI teaser both die (the letter is its own moment). The invitation line (snap the next plate) rises from 40pt to programHeroDisplay 44pt with its short rule above; the calorie line is promoted to beat-13 grammar: 860 in numeralHero 64pt serif with 'of ~1,473' and the italic 'room for ~600' at 24pt italic serif beneath, replacing the current 40pt mixed one-liner. Protein and steps become two quiet receipt rows (label-left 16pt, value-right 22pt serif), no sparkle glyph, no chevron, no caption. The cycle nudge row (bar + connect pill + X) is deleted. The checklist renders as kept lines (see signature). Bottom 40% of the canvas becomes clear cream; the tab capsule thins to three bare glyphs so it stops occluding. The screen becomes a single typeset invitation for the day instead of a stacked feed.

A bound monthly issue you flip, not a settings table you scan. The italic masthead stays; below jeni's read (the one hero, 38-44pt), the signal index sheds its productivity skin: delete all seven chevrons, the 'tap to open' caption, and the hairlines between rows; each signal becomes a table-of-contents line in the magazine sense, the serif sentence itself at reading 24pt (holding steady this week.) with its tiny caps topic reduced to 10pt and the rose thread-mark of the pagination beside it, entries at ~88pt pitch separated by whitespace alone. Inside, each page keeps its strong hero but the figure becomes the page's only body: the weight chart grows to ~60% of canvas height and loses the STARTED/NOW/GOAL tile row (endpoints annotate the line itself; goal stays as the dashed floor); the protein page keeps one axis label set, not two, and one closing sentence, not two. The ribbon pagination (below) replaces i-of-xii. If the palette lock permits the pageIvory token already sitting in Tokens.swift line 404 as this tab's paper, the room shift becomes physical while staying in-house.

Already the closest surface to the signed register; finish it. Keep the JENI hairline-to-monday header exactly as is (the best chrome in the app). The body rises from 34pt to the full 44pt programHeroDisplay with programHeroLineGap, and the letter block optically centers the way beat 05 centers a statement (today it ends at 42% and leaves a 45% raw void below). One exit only: keep the cocoa reply pill; 'keep it' stops being a second text button and becomes the kept mark itself, a small hollow sparkle at the letter's corner that fills jeweledRose when touched, so keeping the letter is the same gesture as keeping anything in this app. jeni's italic sign-off with the heart stays right-aligned as the only ornament.

Strip the iMessage cosplay; the letter moment already proves jeni's words carry more weight typeset bare on cream. Delete bubble fills, tails, and shadows: jeni's turns become left-aligned cocoa text blocks (19pt) with a hairline paragraph rhythm, her replies right-aligned in accent rose italic serif, whitespace and the existing italic 'today' hairline dividers doing all separation. The embedded trend card loses its white container; the line chart sits bare between two hairlines full width. The input thins from a white rounded field to a single hairline-underlined line of text with the sparkle mark as the send glyph. What grows: line length and air between turns. What dies: every white surface in the thread. The screen reads as ongoing correspondence in the same paper as the rest of the house.

Beat 13 is the signed food register; the live result must hold it without addition. Photo full-bleed to all four edges for the top ~50%; one cream sheet rises with the dish name as a 17pt quiet line, the kcal in numeralHero 64-72pt serif with the italic serif unit word beside, protein at the second scale, then bare ingredient receipt rows (name-left, number-right, 1px hairlines, no steppers visible at rest), one italic verdict line (it fits.), one cocoa pill. No rings, bars, or macro tiles anywhere near the numeral; carousel dots reduce to the same thread grammar as becoming. On Home, the dark camera chip remains the only dark chrome on the screen, which makes it the obvious ceremony trigger. The dish photograph is the imagery budget of the entire app; let it be the biggest thing the user sees all day.

checklist_signature.at_rest: No circle, no card, no status caption. An unkept item is a line of intent set in 26pt JeniHeroSerif at 72% cocoa (snap a meal), sitting on a 1px hairlineCocoa underline that runs the text width plus a 24pt overhang; at the underline's far end waits a hollow jeni mark: the tab bar's four-point sparkle at 12pt, 1pt stroke, 25% cocoa. Rows at 64pt pitch, separated by whitespace only. The current p4_home_evening_list grammar (44pt stroked radio circle + 'still open' caption, half-buried under the tab capsule) is deleted entirely; the radio circle stays exclusive to onboarding questions where it means choice, never state.
checklist_signature.completion: Tap anywhere on the line. The sentence inks from 72% to full cocoa; a rose light (accentSubtle into accent) sweeps left to right along the hairline over ~420ms; when the sweep reaches the end, the hollow mark fills jeweledRose and blooms 1.0 to 1.4 to 1.0 with a 4pt sparkle flare, and a quiet past-tense receipt sets itself under the line end in 13pt italic serif (kept, 7:42). Haptics are a two-beat phrase: a light tick at the touch, then a medium swell timed exactly to the mark's landing ~320ms later, so the reward lands in the hand at the same instant the sparkle fills. Nothing strikes through, nothing reorders, nothing turns green.
checklist_signature.day_complete: When the last line's mark fills, every kept mark on the screen glows once in sequence (80ms stagger, top to bottom), then a single small filled sparkle takes its place beside the date eyebrow: MONDAY, JULY 27 ✦. The list beneath exhales: kept lines ease to 40% opacity and the section's whitespace opens by +16pt, the way a desk looks when the day's papers are put away. One warm haptic swell, longer than any single keep. That evening's letter arrives with the same mark pre-printed after jeni's sign-off, so the day's close and her acknowledgment share one glyph.
checklist_signature.why_inevitable: It introduces zero new shapes: the mark is the sparkle she already touches in the tab bar every day, the hairline is the app's only line, rose is the app's only accent, and 'kept' is the app's own word. Completion is re-inking a sentence rather than checking a box, which is precisely the difference between a task manager and a kept promise; and because the choreography ends in the hand (the haptic swell on the mark's landing), it is felt once and expected forever.

becoming_pagination.description: Kill i-of-xii. At the foot of every becoming page runs a single 1px cocoa hairline the width of the text column: the book's edge. Your place in the issue is a short rose segment on that thread, its length exactly 1/n of the line, its position your page; it tracks the finger live during the swipe and settles with the page, like a bookmark ribbon sliding along the foot of a bound issue. No numerals, no countable dots: position is felt as material place (how far the ribbon has traveled, how much thread remains) the way a thumb feels remaining pages in a magazine. On the final page the segment arrives at the end and the thread fills rose entirely, landing a tiny jeni mark at its tip, the issue's colophon. Built from three existing materials only: hairlineCocoa, accent rose, the sparkle.

deletions: p5_functional_home: the FROM JENI teaser row, an italic serif line that truncates mid-word ('this is day 12, n...') with its arrow; the letter is its own moment and must never appear ellipsized.

p5_functional_home / p4_list_home: the second caps eyebrow (DAY 12 · WEEK 2 OF 20 · FINDING STEADY >), which truncates to 'FINDING STEA…' on p4; one caps register per screen, and week identity belongs to becoming.
p5_functional_home: the cycle nudge row (vertical bar + 'connect' outline pill + X dismiss): three pieces of chrome for one optional idea.

p4_home_evening_list: the empty radio circle and 'still open' status caption on 'snap a meal' (replaced by the kept line), plus the pill count cut from eight to at most three quiet text choices on one line.
p2_becoming: all seven right chevrons and the 'tap to open' instruction caption in HER SIGNALS; a magazine's contents page needs no disclosure arrows or user manual.
folio_v6: the duplicated axis labels (MORNING/AFTERNOON/EVENING printed twice, six caps labels for three bars) and the gray closing sentence that restates the italic insight already on the page.
folio_scrollpager: the STARTED/NOW/GOAL three-up stat-tile row (endpoints annotate the chart line itself; goal remains the dashed floor) and the roman folio 'i · of xii'.
chat_final: bubble fills, tails, and shadows on every message, and the white container around the embedded trend chart; the chart sits bare between two hairlines.
one_transformative_move: Adopt onboarding's deepest law app-wide: zero elevated surfaces on cream. Delete every white container in the app's interior (chat bubbles and their tails, the embedded trend card, stat tiles, outline pill chips, the settings-table treatment of becoming's index, and the tab capsule thinned to three bare glyphs) so that everything stands as typography directly on cream exactly as all 22 onboarding beats do, with elevation reserved for the one moment UI rides over a photograph, the snap sheet. It is a single measurable rule (non-photo containers across these five surfaces: roughly fourteen today, zero to one after) and it converts chat into correspondence, becoming into an issue, and Home into a ceremony in one stroke, because once the containers are gone, scale and whitespace have no choice but to do the structural work the way the onboarding already does.
